title: Masu Neman Gaskiya Masu Barci
intro: Ka yi tunanin lokacin da aka ƙalubalanci imani, kuma gungun rayuka suka zaɓi amincewa mara misaltuwa maimakon jin daɗin duniya. Da suka fuskanci wani zaɓi mai ban tsoro, suka nemi mafaka, suka fara tafiya da ta kai ga barci mai ban mamaki. Labarinsu shaida ne na kariyar Allah da kuma ikon imani daga zalunci. Za ku iya gane asalin waɗannan mutane masu ban mamaki?
clues: Mun kasance ƙaramin taro, mun haɗu bisa imani mai zurfi ga Mahalicci Ɗaya.
Mun rayu ne a lokacin da wani mai iko ya bukaci bauta wa wanin Allah.
Domin mu kiyaye imaninmu, mun yanke shawarar barin gidajenmu mu gudu daga zaluncin.
Wani abokin tarayya mai aminci, dabbar duniya, ya raka mu a tafiyarmu.
Mun sami mafaka a wani wuri mai keɓancewa, inda Allah ya sa muka shiga barci mai zurfi mai tsawo.
Da muka farka, mun yi imani cewa kwana ɗaya ko wani ɓangare na rana ne kawai ya wuce, amma ƙarni da yawa sun shuɗe.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Ana gwada shi da ƙasa mara amfani
Neman mafaka daga azzalumi mai mulki
Ana jefa shi cikin wuta mai ƙonewa
trial.answer: Neman mafaka daga azzalumi mai mulki

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Barci mai ban mamaki na ƙarni da yawa
Ceton da za a yi daga guguwa mai halaka
Ana tanadar masa da tebur na sama
outcome.answer: Barci mai ban mamaki na ƙarni da yawa

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
